snapshot: Initial tools/trainer Python responsibility inventory before native replacements, 2026-10-29
policy: Only PyTorch responsibilities remain Python. Import classification is an inventory, not a retention approval.
audit_status: The files array preserves the initial inventory, including retired paths. The replacement map and audited responsibilities below record follow-up decisions; unreviewed support modules are not approved for retention.

audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/tensor_io4.py: Thin persistent tensor-worker transport only; native tensor-io owns reserve/write/commit/abort, filesystem locks, file sync, temporary cleanup and atomic publication. Explicit successful Torch serialization handshake is required; EOF, failed serialization and truncated raw blocks abort. Raw feature records cross once per complete unroll batch without hex expansion.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/checkpoint4.py: Torch serialization, RNG and optimizer-state handling only. Native tensor-io owns unique checkpoint temporary paths, flushing, atomic replacement and abort cleanup; failed Torch serialization preserves the previous checkpoint.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/model4/structure.py: Torch rule encoder remains; canonical structure identity delegates to native compact sorted ASCII JSON digest with original float formatting.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/value_calibration4/cache.p: Thin NumPy mmap/Torch tensor adapter; native calibration-io owns identity/default-spaced canonical key, complete metadata, file size/content admission and eligible-record indices.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/value_calibration4/extract: Torch chronological inference and tensor-record serialization remain; native tensor-io owns raw file writes, cache locks, reservation, commit/abort and complete metadata publication.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/value_calibration4/checkpo: Torch source/model loading and head-only tensor merging remain; native calibration-io validates/seals collection plans and tensor-io owns locked non-overwriting compound checkpoint/report publication.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/training4/bc_mixture/cycli: Thin callback adapter only: invokes complete chronological Torch sampler passes. Native bc-cycle owns epoch planning, budget, padding, repeat-prefix selection and receipts. One initialization plus one native call per whole source pass; never one call per batch/frame.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/value_calibration4/metrics: Torch prediction execution and NumPy/JSON transport only. Native calibration-metrics owns trajectory weights, grouped Brier/calibration statistics, training priors and game overlap; reporting crosses the boundary once per complete prediction pass.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/training4/diagnostics/stat: On-device Torch step_statistics and tensor-to-host transfer remain. Native diagnostic-metrics owns host merges, clustering and report ratios. One native merge per whole unroll batch plus one report call; current explicit state transport scales with retained group/game count and can later use a persistent worker if measurement justifies it.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/training4/optimizer_groups: Retained Torch parameter/optimizer scheduling: inspects net.named_parameters and requires_grad, partitions AdamW groups, sets optimizer learning rates and checks the corresponding continuation protocol.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/train4.py, tools/trainer/t: Thin compatibility entry points into PyTorch training/calibration/benchmark execution, with no independent orchestration implementation.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/training4/diagnostics/data: Retained DiagnosticDataset tensor metadata decoding/construction and thin Provenance adapter; source-marker scanning, file receipts, namespace identity and completed-job format binding delegated to native diagnostic-provenance.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/training4/package_state.py: Retained: torch.load, model/optimizer state restoration and tensor device migration at package boundaries.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/benchmark_state4.py: Retained: instantiate and restore the PyTorch recurrent trajectory batch sampler used with checkpoint memory.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/encoder_contract.py: Thin Torch model-configuration bridge only; encoder and warmstart admission delegated to native training-contract.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/training4/depth_schedule.p: Retained dataclass/API and tensor execution phase selection, tensor batch decision/weight reductions, independent Torch evaluations; schedule admission, identity and resume checks delegated to native training-contract.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/training4/bc_mixture/metad: Thin Torch sampler-index bridge only; filesystem scanning, stream receipts, record/table identity and overlap rejection delegated to native trajectory_cache4.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/trajectory_store4/__init__: Read-only NumPy mmap decoding for torch.utils.data.Dataset and thin subprocess bridge only. Native Rust owns shard parsing, raw packing, validation, fingerprints, cache construction and publication.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/training4/loss_config.py: Thin immutable PyTorch objective configuration dataclass; native training-contract owns version, normalization, fixed weights, flags and supported ablation admission.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/training4/supervised_optio: Thin Torch CLI option binding and native training-contract admission bridge plus direct Torch auxiliary head detach/forward. Native supervised_execution validates reference execution and package-state continuation against the objective version.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/test_encoder8_contract.py: Existing untracked PyTorch model/checkpoint/export integration tests retained; imports adapted to native dataset validation. Not authored by this migration.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/performance5/runner.py: Torch disposable CUDA update/parity execution remains; checkpoint checksums and atomic JSON reports delegate to native torch_io4 seals/publication.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/deepen4.py: Torch function-preserving residual-block insertion and checkpoint tensor copying remain; source SHA256 and depth-transfer metadata publication delegate to native operations.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/refresh_structure4.py: Torch rule-encoder parameter remapping, strict model loading and state construction remain; immutable file seals and metadata publication delegate to native operations.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/migrate_structure4.py: Explicit historical Torch weight migration remains; input file SHA256 delegates to native operations.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/dataset3.py, tools/trainer: Supported v3 Torch tensor loader/NumPy mmap adapter retained. Native trajectory_cache4 merge3 validates sizes/offsets/source content seals and streams immutable rebased column caches; old legacy merged artifacts are preserved.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/batch_audit5/worker.py: CPU Torch dataset/sampler execution, encoded-frame Tensor schemas, real collation and Tensor storage/masked counts only. Native audit_batches5 owns job argv, deterministic sample indices, shape/budget arithmetic, quantiles, source seals, hard worker deadline and final report publication.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/bench_inference4.py: Torch/ONNX inference and synchronized measurement remain; native legacy_metrics owns sampled-row planning, stable entity-size frame selection, NumPy-compatible median/linear quantiles and throughput ratios.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/bench_step.py: Torch synthetic model, disposable updates and synchronized timing remain; native legacy_metrics owns training rates, unit conversion, Python median/indexed p95 and ties-even report rounding.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/bench_t1.py: Torch disposable synthetic updates, ONNX export/inference and measurement remain; native legacy_metrics owns NumPy-compatible linear percentile statistics, rounding and resource/throughput reports. This historical v4 probe is not a current v5 capacity benchmark.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/bench_training4.py: Torch disposable update/parity/profiler execution remains; native legacy_metrics owns measured timing reductions and frame/decision throughput. The historical v4 update helper remains callable by compile_probe4; it is not an admitted current v5 training recipe.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/training4/validation.py: Reference recurrent Torch forward/loss/masking and tensor sufficient statistics remain; native legacy_metrics owns bounded per-batch calibration/metric accumulation and final reporting. No host NumPy calibration reductions remain.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/test_native_benchmark4.py: Direct tests of retained Torch timing and recurrent validation boundaries; checks native quantile, sampling, rounding and report parity against former NumPy/statistics semantics without training updates.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/train3.py: Torch forward/loss/optimizer and model selection remain; native legacy_metrics owns final policy agreement/chance/group reductions, team/draw/first-step value report slices, Markdown and atomic JSON/report publication.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/train_policy.py: Torch policy training and model selection remain; native legacy_metrics owns final agreement/chance/group reductions and Markdown/JSON report publication, preserving the historical distinct profile threshold.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/train_rl.py: Torch v3 RL tensor updates remain; shared native value-slice reductions and torch_io4 atomic_json publish the final report without Python filesystem writes.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/eval_value.py: Retained v2 Torch model loading and prediction; native legacy_metrics fits the disjoint even-game baseline, selects odd-game first decisions, aggregates proper scores/calibration and writes reports.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/eval_shift.py: Retained v3 Torch model/option inference and Tensor probability/KL sufficient statistics; native legacy_metrics owns cross-batch reductions, agreement/entropy/hit ratios, finite advantage grouping and report rendering.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/train_value.py, tools/trai: Retained legacy Torch model training, loss/backpropagation, optimizer and direct Tensor feature/prediction adapters. Native legacy_metrics owns metrics, group thresholds/statistics, Markdown rendering and JSON/Markdown report publication. Torch training/forward/optimizer bodies preserved; native statistical reductions use f64.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/legacy_evaluation/__init__: Thin JSON/subprocess transport for Torch-derived prediction and advantage arrays; no Python aggregation or fallback.
audited_responsibilities.tools/trainer/test_audit_batches5.py, to: Directly associated Torch tensor/storage, legacy mmap and real native-boundary integration fixtures; pure planner/cache/statistical unit tests moved to Rust.

baylee-train-ops trajectory_cache4 pack and trajectory::packing library
retired_operational_entries.tools/trainer/audit_batches5.py: baylee-train-ops audit_batches5 CLI; batch_audit5/worker.py retains only CPU Torch measurements
